actual_tools: Biological Sequence & Alignment Viewer 0.1.43 diagnostic attempts recorded in outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json
execution.implementation: verified local NC_001416.1 regional FASTA and GFF3 extraction, one timed-out Viewer track attempt, and a genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation

observations: NC_001416.1 records cI at complement(37227..37940) and OR3, OR2, and OR1 downstream on the forward strand.
The extracted source interval 37180..38050 is 871 bases and maps to local coordinates 1..871.
Rosalind Workbench returned its ready task chooser for the recorded case-specific invocation.
Two genuine sequence_load_track requests timed out without viewer acknowledgement; the fresh records readiness query and tracks follow-up query also timed out.
The 2026-08-30 Viewer review retained no successful Sequence Viewer operation; failed and unexecuted actions are mapped in outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json.
interpretation: The regional GFF3 preserves both local display coordinates and the exact source accession and positions for four selected annotations.
limitations: The track contains four selected features and is not a complete GenBank conversion.
The Viewer did not acknowledge either load request or the fresh readiness and tracks queries, so parsing, mapping, display, and retention of the GFF3 remain unverified.
rosalind_open did not execute a scientific job and did not receive the regional FASTA or GFF3.
No Sequence Viewer capability is claimed because the server-created sessions never produced a query-confirmed mounted viewer.

reproduction: From the repository root run python showcases/biological-sequence-viewer/cases/sequence-annotation-track/build_case.py.
Compare the GFF3 with outputs/annotation-summary.csv and inspect both attempts in outputs/sequence-load-track-observation.json before making any Viewer claim.
Treat sequence_load_track as uncovered until a later acknowledged response returns mapping diagnostics and queryable track state.
Inspect outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json and do not promote failed or unexecuted Viewer actions to capabilities.
